capabilities: Stage, commit, pull, and push changed files from a Git sidebar
Compare versions in editable side-by-side diffs and restore individual blocks
Browse a commit graph and per-file history, including renames and image comparisons
Create and switch branches, and save and restore stashes
Resolve rebase conflicts by editing a merged result and continuing or aborting
extras: Desktop only and requires the vault to be initialized as a Git repository. Includes an unrelated side feature that renders Markdown tables without a preceding blank line, plus English/Chinese UI and published performance benchmarks for version 1.0.7.
problem: Obsidian has no built-in Git support, so users must leave the app to stage, commit, branch, and resolve conflicts in their vault.
summary: Git source control interface for Obsidian with a sidebar for staging and commits, editable diffs, a commit graph, branches, stashes, and conflict resolution.
